extracted.intended_audience: journalists, editors, publishers, and complainants in Germany
extracted.subtask_description: Applying and interpreting the Deutscher Pressekodex (German Press Code) as guidance for journalistic practice and as the basis for assessing complaints about press conduct. The code's 16 clauses set ethical standards for reporting and editorial conduct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Achtung der Menschenwürde
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed among the topics covered by the Pressekodex; one of the ethical principles used by the DRPR to judge complaints. Part of the 16 Ziffern that form the code's substantive requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unschuldsvermutung
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Named explicitly as a principle of the Pressekodex (presumption of innocence). Used to evaluate reporting that concerns alleged wrongdoing and to protect against prejudicial coverage before legal determination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opferschutz
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Victim protection is a stated principle of the code. Guides how victims should be treated in reporting (privacy, dignity, avoidance of revictimization) and is considered in complaint assessments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trennung von Werbung und Redaktion
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit requirement to separate advertising from editorial content. Guidance used to judge unacceptable blending of commercial content with independent reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Die 16 Ziffern des Pressekodex als Grundlage für Beschwerden
rubrics_metrics.description: Die 16 Ziffern des Pressekodex sind Grundlage für die Beurteilung der bei uns eingereichten Beschwerden.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The code's 16 numbered clauses constitute the basis for the DRPR's complaint adjudication. The page notes that most German publishers commit to observe the Pressekodex, indicating its role as an industry standard.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verweis auf ‚Ethische Standards‘
rubrics_metrics.description: Die Ethischen Standards finden sie hier.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page points to a separate document ('Ethische Standards') as further detailed guidance. Serves as an additional reference containing more specific norms and explanations (link indicated on the page).
